notice.suspended: Your account is suspended until {date}. You can't post, edit, send messages, add to your wishlist, or report.
notice.reset: Your password was reset ({date}, {how}). If you didn't do this, change your password and security question right away.
lang.title: Language
lang.hint: Changes the language of menus and labels. Posts and messages written by others stay as written.
err.network: Can't connect to the server. Please try again in a moment.
err.generic: Couldn't process your request. Please try again in a moment.
err.status.400: This request can't be completed right now.

err.status.403: You don't have permission to do this.

val.email: Please enter a valid email address.
login.joined: You're signed up. Please log in.
login.reset_done: Your password has been changed. Please log in with your new password.
signup.nickname_hint: 2–30 characters. Shown to other students as your seller name.
signup.duplicate: That email or nickname is already in use.
reset.title: Reset password
reset.intro: You can reset your password by answering the security question you set when you signed up.
reset.answer_hint: Spaces and capitalization don't matter. After 5 wrong answers in 24 hours, you can't reset for a day.
reset.verify_ok: Verified. Please set a new password within 10 minutes.
reset.admin_note: Admin accounts can't be reset here. They are reset with a server admin command.
reset.wrong_answer: The email or answer is incorrect.
reset.too_many: Too many attempts. Please try again later.
reset.expired: Your verification has expired or is invalid. Please verify again.

home.hero_sub: Sell the books you're done with. Get the ones you need for less.
home.hero_member: Have textbooks you no longer use?
home.title: Used textbooks
home.page_empty: No posts on this page. (Total: {total}, last page: {pages})
pwa.close_aria: Close the Add to Home Screen tip

sq.custom_hint: 5–60 characters. Don't put the answer or a hint in the question, and avoid questions friends or family could easily guess.
sq.hint: If you forget your password, you'll reset it by answering this question.
sq.answer_hint: Pick an answer others can't easily guess. Spaces and capitalization don't matter. (2–20 characters, not counting spaces)
sq.custom_too_short: Please write a question of at least 5 characters.
sq.answer_too_short: The answer must be at least 2 characters, not counting spaces.
sq.answer_too_long: The answer must be 20 characters or fewer, not counting spaces.
question.CHILDHOOD_SHOP: What was the name of a shop you often went to in your childhood neighborhood?
question.FIRST_BOOK_OR_ALBUM: What was the title of the first book or album you bought?
question.CHILDHOOD_FRIEND_NICKNAME: What was the nickname of your best friend in elementary school?
question.FIRST_PART_TIME_JOB: What was the name of the place where you had your first part-time job?
question.CHILDHOOD_TOY_NAME: What name did you give a favorite doll or toy as a child?
question.SCHOOL_CLUB: What club were you in during middle or high school?
question.FIRST_AWARD: What was the name of the first award or certificate you received?
question.FAMILY_RESTAURANT: What restaurant did your family often go to when you were a child?
question.FIRST_SOLO_TRIP_STAY: Where did you stay (the place or neighborhood) on your first solo trip?
safety.report_done: Your report has been received. The other person won't be told about the report or who made it.
safety.block_done: Blocked. You can't message each other, and this user's posts won't appear in the list.
safety.block_list: You can view and unblock users in {@term.me}.
safety.confirm_block:
Block {nickname}?

· You won't be able to message each other.
· {nickname}'s posts won't appear in the list.
· {@safety.block_list}
safety.confirm_unblock: Unblock {nickname}? You'll be able to message each other again, and their posts will appear in the list.
safety.confirm_leave:
Leave the conversation with {nickname}?

· It disappears only from your inbox and stays for the other person.
· If they send a new message it will reappear, but earlier messages won't be shown.
report.hint: The other person won't be told about the report or who made it. False reports may lead to penalties.
report.other_needs_description: Please add details when choosing Other.
buyer.no_candidates: No one has exchanged messages with you about this post.
buyer.hint: You and the person you choose can each leave one trade review.
buyer.choose: Choose your trade partner, or choose “{@buyer.none_short}”.
review.title: {@term.review}
review.hint: Reviews are shown on the other person's profile and can't be edited or deleted once posted.
post.blocked_seller: You blocked this user. You can't send messages until you unblock them.
post.login_hint: Log in to send a message or see contact options. {login}
post.sold_notice: Sold posts can't be edited. Until a review is left, you can put it back on sale.
post.buyer_locked: Can't be changed because a review has been left.
post.confirm_revert: Put this back on sale? The trade partner record will be removed, and neither of you will be able to leave a review.
post.sell_intro: Once a review is left, you can't put it back on sale. You can change the trade partner until a review is left.
post.change_buyer_intro: You can change this only until a review is left. The review period counts from the day it was first marked as sold.
post.confirm_delete: Delete this post? This can't be undone.
form.not_owner: You can only edit your own posts.
field.title: Title
form.course_hint: The course filter on the list only finds exact matches.
form.price_hint: A price of 0 is shown as “{@term.free}”.
form.open_chat_hint: Only KakaoTalk Open Chat links are allowed. They're shown only to logged-in users and hidden once the item is sold.
form.photos_hint: JPG, PNG, WebP or HEIC, up to 3 photos. Large photos are resized automatically before upload. Location data (GPS) in photos isn't saved. Selected photos upload right away and are deleted automatically if you don't post.
form.photo_type: {name}: Only JPG, PNG, WebP and HEIC photos can be uploaded.
form.photo_limit: You can upload up to {max} photos, so {name} was left out.
form.photo_too_big: {name}: Each photo must be 25MB or smaller.
form.photo_restore_full: You can have up to {max} photos. Remove a new photo first to restore this one.
form.photo_failed_remain: Some photos failed to upload. Try again or remove them.
user.manner_default: No trade reviews yet, so this is the starting GPA.

chat.blocked_by_me: You blocked this user. Unblock them to send messages again.
chat.cannot_send: You can't send messages to this user.

chat.unstable: Connection is unstable. Checking again shortly.
chat.photo_too_big: Each photo can be up to 25MB.

inbox.page_empty: No conversations on this page. (Total: {total}, last page: {pages})
inbox.left: You left the conversation. It will reappear if they send a new message.

alerts.price_integer: Enter a whole number of 0 or more.

blocks.page_empty: No blocked users on this page. (Total: {total}, last page: {pages})
me.email_fixed: Your email is your login ID, so it can't be changed.
me.nickname_hint: 2–30 characters · can be changed once every 30 days.
me.nickname_hint_until: 2–30 characters · you can change it again from {date}.
me.question_intro: If you forget your password, you can reset it with the answer to this question. Once you set a new one, the old question and answer stop working right away.
me.withdraw_intro: Deleting your account removes all your listings, photos, wishlist, and blocked users, and can't be undone. Messages you exchanged stay with the other person under "Deleted user".
me.empty_wishlist: Your wishlist is empty. Tap the heart on a textbook you like.
me.nickname_too_short: Nickname must be at least 2 characters.
me.password_changed: Password changed. You'll need to log in again on other devices.
me.confirm_withdraw: Delete your account? All your listings, photos, wishlist, and blocked users will be removed.
me.confirm_withdraw_final: This can't be undone. Last check: delete your account?
me.withdrawn: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for using Campus Books.
me.question_missing: You don't have a security question yet. Tap "{@term.security_question}" to set one. Without it, you can't reset a forgotten password.
me.question_locked: Because your password was reset with this question, you can change it from {date}.
